watermark.reason: BC Stencil has no public date-filter API (Storefront GraphQL is auth-gated). Sort=newest verified honored via 3-outcome counter-control on /firearms/ (default alphaasc Adler vs newest Sako vs counter alphadesc Zastava — three distinct first-product slugs). Pagination ?page=N zero-overlap verified between p1 and p2 with sort=newest&limit=100. perPage=100 verified honored (max <select name="limit"> option, returns exactly 100 cards on page 1).

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Sum of in-stock per-category counts (walked, sort=newest&limit=100) = 7,163. Authoritative bc-xmlsitemap product count = 16,985. Gap = 9,822 (~58%). The gap is OOS products: BC Stencil hides out-of-stock items from category listings by default but includes ALL products (in-stock + OOS) in /xmlsitemap.php?type=products. The 16,985 sitemap count is the operator's chosen authoritative inventory size because OOS products must be tracked for restock alerts. /clearance/ overlaps with other categories at runtime; cross-category dedup happens via product URL during crawl indexing.

auditNotes.harnessVersion: AI-driven, post-2026-04-27 pivot, calibration re-run with operator corrections

stageNotes.stage1: Apex (store.theshootingcentre.com) returned 200 cleanly with no <link rel="canonical"> override. canonicalOrigin = https://store.theshootingcentre.com.
stageNotes.stage2: 8-batch heavy probe: cf-ray on every request, BC-Ray response header, x-bc-store-id: 1000882963. Baseline GETs (Batch 1, 2, 3, 5, 8) all 200. Batch 4 honeypot paths (/wp-admin, /wp-login.php, /.env, /.git/config, /phpinfo.php) return 403 — Cloudflare path-selective rules. Batch 6 UNION-SELECT and Batch 7 XSS-shaped queries return 403 — Cloudflare rule-selective. No challenge bodies, no _cf_chl_opt, no sucuri/incapsula/akamai/malcare markers. hasCaptcha=false (no recaptcha/hcaptcha/turnstile in homepage HTML).
stageNotes.stage3: Identified BigCommerce Stencil from cdn11.bigcommerce.com asset prefix, BC-Ray response header, x-bc-store-id: 1000882963, and stencil-prefixed CSS classes. No age-gate markers in homepage (412KB body grep for 'age verif|18 years|legal age|i am 18|date of birth|agegate|dob' returns 0). Maintain verifyMethod = detail-page (not WooCommerce, no public batch product API on BC).
stageNotes.stage4: Top-level catalog set extracted from <ul class="navPages-list navPages-list--categories"> first ul: 8 has-subMenu entries — firearms, optics, ammunition, reloading, gun-parts-accessories, optics-accessories, gear, clearance. /gunsmithing/ (visible in homepage links but NOT in main nav category list) is a services info page (h1=Services, h2=Rifles/Pistols/Shotguns service descriptions, 0 product cards) — dropped from catalogUrls. Brand-shortcut homepage links (/browning/, /federal/, /hornady/, /leupold/, /magpul/, /sitka-gear/, /tikka/, /vortex-optics/, /weatherby/, /yeti/) are brand filters that overlap with category pages — dropped. Page-1 walk on each candidate confirmed 100 cards extracted per category (using awk multi-line on h4.card-title -> a href). Extraction spot-check: 3 random product detail pages (positions 1, 50, 100 from /firearms/?sort=newest&limit=100 page 1) all returned title (>5 chars), price (>$0), and JSON-LD availability=InStock. extractionTested=true.
stageNotes.stage5: Tested ?page=N pagination on /firearms/?sort=newest&limit=100 — page 1 returned 100 distinct product slugs (Sako 90 / Franchi Momentum / Derya TM22 first 3), page 2 returned 100 distinct product slugs (Tikka T3x Tact A1 / Tikka T3x Hunter / Sako S20 Precision first 3), comm -12 overlap = 0 of 100. paginationPattern.type=query, template='page' (param name only per Mistake 14), perPage=100, firstPageHasParam=false, startPage=1, zeroIndexed=false.
stageNotes.stage6: <select name="sort" id="sortsb"> options: featured, newest, bestselling, alphaasc, alphadesc, avgcustomerreview, priceasc, pricedesc. Default on /firearms/ is alphaasc (selected attribute). 3-outcome counter-control test: default first product = Adler Arms RF-224 TAC (alpha-A start), ?sort=newest first product = Sako 90 Finnlight, ?sort=alphadesc first product = Zastava Yugoslavian SKS 59/66. All three first-products differ -> sort honored (Mistake 29 BC Stencil false-negative trap avoided — default is NOT featured/newest equivalence). sortParam='?sort=newest', sortVerified=true.
stageNotes.stage7: Method A (api-date-since-watermark) not available — BC Stencil has no public date-filter API; Storefront GraphQL is auth-gated and BC Catalog REST API is admin-side. Method B (navigate-from-watermark) qualifies: Stage 6 verdict=honored, Stage 5 zero-overlap pagination verified, sort=newest is monotonic newest-first. crawlers.watermark.method='navigate-from-watermark'.
stageNotes.stage8: Operator-mandated method: bc-xmlsitemap (Stage 8 priority order #7, ahead of catalog-walk-only #12). Fetched /xmlsitemap.php (sitemap index): 3 product sitemap pages — type=products page=1/2/3. Per-page <loc> counts: p1=3132, p2=9997, p3=3856. Total = 16,985. All <loc> entries have product-shape URLs (/<slug>/) — no category, brand, or info-page URLs leak into the products sitemap. expectedProductCount=16985, productCountMethod='bc-xmlsitemap'. This count is OOS-inclusive (BC Stencil hides OOS from category listings but includes all products in xmlsitemap) — required for restock-alert coverage.
